fields.subject: Kobayashi Isamu no seikyū ni kansuru zenmon dokyumento no tōgō
fields.summary: Minsei bu to gunji bu no aida no mujun meirei ni kansuru subete no shōko to hōkoku o tōgō shi, seikyū o ukeireru kettei o kōsei suru.

claims.fact: Dossie gaiyō wa zenmon dokyumento o tōgō shi seikyū no ukeire o kakutei suru.
